title: Customer Success Manager
description:

WHO ARE WE? We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy! CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention. Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including: CloudSEK’s Product Suite: CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support. A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets. CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies. Key Milestones: 2016: Launched our first product. 2018: Secured Pre-series A funding. 2019: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas. 2020: Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year. 2021: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures. Awards & Recognition: Won NetApp Excellerator's\ "Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award. 2025: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault. Job Description: As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK, you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions. Your role will involve deep engagement with clients, providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products. Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients. Key Responsibilities: Account Management: Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention. Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement. Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs. Cybersecurity Expertise: Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues. Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform. Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions. Customer Engagement: Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs. Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals. Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery. Revenue Generation and Retention: Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services. Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate. Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities. Product Usage and Feedback: Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers. Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements. Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement. Operational Excellence: Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems. Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles. Ideal candidate: 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity & Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry. Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients. Strong language proficiency over English and Portuguese is required. Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth. Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously. Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills: Business reviews: Onsite meetings Maintaining NRR and GRR Threat analysis and Value delivery Benefits of Joining CloudSEK: We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include: Flexible working hours. Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office. And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here! CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

O PMA é uma solução desenvolvida internamente, e ambas as plataformas estão sendo entregues em parceria com um integrador de sistemas terceirizado. Como parte dessa transformação, estamos construindo uma capacidade global de suporte L1/L2/L3 para garantir estabilidade, performance e adoção em todos os mercados. Responsabilidades: Estamos buscando um Desenvolvedor Sênior com perfil hands-on para atuar em um ambiente de suporte em produção, suportando e estabilizando o ecossistema de CRM e do Panel Member App. Essa função é focada na análise e resolução de problemas complexos em um ambiente operacional multinacional, trabalhando em conjunto com times internos e com o integrador de sistemas para implementar correções e melhorias. Fornecer suporte técnico L2/L3 para CRM (Dynamics 365), Panel Member App e integrações;
Diagnosticar eresolverproblemas complexos em sistemas distribuídos (CRM, mobile, APIs, backend e camadas de dados), utilizando logs, ferramentas de monitoramento e telemetria;
Apoiar gestão de incidentes, correção de defeitos e ciclos de release para garantir estabilidade em produção;
Realizar análise de causa raiz (root cause analysis) para identificar a origem dos problemas (aplicação, integração, dados, infraestrutura ou segurança);
Interagir com stakeholders operacionais, de produto e regionais para priorizar issues e comunicar causas, impactos e ações de resolução;
Diagnosticar problemase coordenar com o integrador e times internos para implementar correções nas plataformas relevantes;
Analisar fluxos de dados e garantir consistência entre sistemas integrados;
Manter documentação clara e compartilhar conhecimento com o time. Requisitos: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Mais de 7 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software ou suporte em produção. Suporte em Produção & Diagnóstico (Crítico): Experiência sólida em ambientes de suporte L2/L3 (preferencialmente além de experiência apenas em projetos);
Excelentes habilidadesde diagnóstico e troubleshooting em sistemas distribuídos complexos;
Experiência comprovadaem ambientes operacionais reativos (ex: call center, operações de campo, plataformas voltadas ao cliente). Tecnologia & Sistemas: Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento, logging ou observabilidade em ambientes produtivos;
Experiência emambientes corporativos complexos com sistemas modernos e legados;
Conhecimento em Microsoft Dynamics 365 e Power Platform (foco em troubleshooting, não desenvolvimento principal);
Experiência com arquiteturas de integração (REST APIs, GraphQL, sistemas orientados a eventos);
Conhecimento em aplicações mobile (iOS/Android) e sistemas operacionais como telefonia ou field service;
Visão ampla deaplicações, dados, infraestrutura e segurança em sistemas distribuídos;
Familiaridade com ferramentas DevOps e ambientes múltiplos (Dev, QA, UAT, Prod). Diferenciais: Experiência com Dynamics 365 em produção;
Experiência emplataformas globais e multi-país;
Experiência com modelos de entrega envolvendo integradores de sistema (SI). Idioma: Inglês fundamental nível avançado. Por que se juntar a nós? Atuará de forma central na transformação de um dos principais domínios de produto e da maior operação global da empresa;
Trabalhará em mudançasde alto impacto, em escala global;
Colaborará comstakeholders seniores, líderes de produto e especialistas técnicos globais;
Oportunidade de equilibrar entrega prática (hands-on) com transformação de longo prazo. O que oferecemos? Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade: Vale Refeição e Alimentação Horário Flexível Modelo de trabalho remoto Assistência Médica e Odontológica Convênio Farmácia Participação nos Lucros e Resultados Previdência Privada Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos Convênio com empresas parceiras Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe;
Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais Programa de Mobilidade Interna: valorizamos talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você! No IBOPE a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Ip Translation And Filing Client Care Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ip Translation And Filing Client Care Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. IP Translation and Filing Client Care Specialist Sun IP is a global leader in patent translation, foreign filing, and annuity solutions, helping intellectual property professionals protect innovation worldwide. We are looking for a motivated, process-focused, IP-knowledgeable Client Care Specialist to join our Filings and Translations department — a collaborative team dedicated to delivering exceptional service to a sophisticated global clientele. Success in this role demands genuine IP knowledge and a meticulous eye for detail. You will be working across a high volume of concurrent matters, each with its own instructions, deadlines, and data requirements — so the ability to prioritize accurately and act before things escalate is essential. You will take a proactive approach to every interaction: anticipating what a client needs, ensuring records are complete and correct, and entering data with the precision that IP demands. This is not a reactive role. It is one where staying ahead of the work, asking the right questions early, and keeping every case moving is what defines a great day. This is a role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment and takes genuine satisfaction in getting the details right. You will manage multiple matters simultaneously across a diverse client base, bringing IP expertise, sharp judgment, and a client-first mindset to everything you do. Main Responsibilities Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of global IP clients, handling enquiries with professionalism, accuracy, and a proactive approach to resolution. Process patent translation requests in connection with international filings, ensuring all instructions are interpreted correctly and actioned without delay. Manage client correspondence across high-volume shared inboxes, triaging and prioritizing matters according to urgency and deadline sensitivity. Enter and maintain accurate data within our workflow management platform, upholding data integrity at every stage. Follow up with clients on outstanding filing requirements, documentation, and approaching deadlines — anticipating gaps before they become issues. Analyze complex filing instructions and translate them into clear, actionable tasks for internal teams, removing ambiguity and keeping matters on track. Collaborate cross-functionally with Project Management, Accounting, Sales, and other departments to coordinate client deliverables and resolve escalations. Identify and resolve inconsistencies or errors in client instructions, escalating where necessary and always keeping the client informed. Produce and manipulate reports in Microsoft Excel to support internal tracking, client updates, and workflow oversight. Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by sharing process insights and supporting broader team and company objectives. Manage proactive client contact, ensuring clients are kept informed at every stage of their matters and no update is left outstanding. Act as primary contact for client profile management, maintaining accurate account records, preferences, and filing instructions across all platforms. Lead client onboarding, guiding new clients through Sun IP’s processes, systems, and service offering to ensure a confident and informed start. Deliver virtual training sessions for clients, equipping them with the knowledge to work effectively with our team and tools. Required Experience Prior experience in the patent filing industry;
experience as a patentfiling paralegal is strongly preferred. Demonstrable experience processing patent translation requests in connection with international patent filings. Hands-on experience with docketing systems or similar workflow management platforms. Experience managing client-facing communication around filing requirements, deadlines, and documentation. Strong verbal and written communication skills - you can explain things clearly and confidently, whether in email, one-to-one call, or group meeting. Skills & Competencies -IP Knowledge & Process Orientation Solid, working understanding of the patent filing lifecycle, related documentation requirements, and the implications of missed deadlines. Ability to parse and act on complex filing instructions quickly and accurately, translating technical requirements into clear, step-by-step tasks. A process-first mindset: you follow established workflows, flag deviations, and continuously look for ways to improve efficiency without sacrificing quality. -Client Focus & Communication Genuine commitment to client service — you take ownership of queries, communicate proactively, and never let a matter fall through the cracks. Professional written and verbal communication skills, including polished client-facing email correspondence and confident participation in meetings. Calm and composed under pressure, with the ability to manage urgent, time-sensitive matters without compromising accuracy or client experience. -Organization & Problem Solving Exceptional attention to detail: you spot errors, inconsistencies, and omissions that others miss, and you act on them decisively. Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with a proven ability to manage a high volume of concurrent matters across varying deadlines. Confident problem-solver who identifies root causes, considers options, and implements solutions - escalating only where genuinely necessary. Ability to manage high-volume shared inboxes effectively, ensuring timely, organized, and consistent responses. -Technical Proficiency Accurate and efficient data entry. Proficiency across multiple software platforms and case management systems;
comfortable onboardingto new tools quickly. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including creating, manipulating, and interpreting reports. Team-oriented and collaborative, with a genuine commitment to supporting colleagues and shared outcomes.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Consultor Científico De Nutrição Infantil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor Científico De Nutrição Infantil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Sobre a Posição

Buscamos profissionais apaixonados por ciência e nutrição infantil para atuar como parceiro estratégico de pediatras, gastropediatras, nutrólogos, neonatologistas e nutricionistas, promovendo educação científica, disseminação de evidências clínicas e construção de relacionamentos de longo prazo com profissionais de saúde.

A atuação é semelhante à de um Medical Science Liaison (MSL) de campo, com foco em geração de valor para os profissionais de saúde e fortalecimento da credibilidade científica da companhia.

Salvador

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Relacionamento Científico
    • Desenvolver relacionamentos de longo prazo com profissionais de saúde estratégicos
    • Realizar visitas presenciais e remotas com abordagem científica consultiva
    • Promover discussões sobre nutrição infantil, alergia alimentar, saúde gastrointestinal e desenvolvimento infantil
    • Identificar necessidades científicas e educacionais dos prescritores
  • Educação Médica
    • Apresentar artigos científicos, revisões sistemáticas, consensos e diretrizes nacionais e internacionais
    • Conduzir reuniões científicas individuais e em grupo
    • Organizar eventos educacionais, webmeetings e jornadas regionais
  • Inteligência de Campo
    • Mapear tendências de mercado e necessidades não atendidas
    • Identificar e desenvolver relacionamento com Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs)
    • Coletar e compartilhar insights científicos relevantes com as áreas Médica, Marketing e Comercial
  • Gestão do Território
    • Planejar e executar estratégia de visitação com foco em cobertura e qualidade
    • Registrar atividades e interações em CRM
    • Atuar em conformidade com NBCAL, regulamentações da ANVISA e código de conduta da companhia
Formação Acadêmica
  • Obrigatória: Nutrição, Farmácia ou Ciências Biológicas
  • Desejável: Pós-graduação em Nutrição Materno-Infantil, Nutrologia, Pediatria, Saúde Baseada em Evidências ou Pesquisa Clínica
Experiência Profissional
  • Valorizamos experiência prévia em uma ou mais das seguintes áreas:
    • Nutrição Infantil ou Nutrição Clínica
    • Fórmulas Infantis
    • Indústria Farmacêutica, Medical Affairs ou Visitação Médica
    • Mercado Hospitalar ou Produtos Pediátricos
  • Diferenciais:
    • Experiência com Pediatria, Nutrologia ou Neonatologia
    • Participação em congressos científicos
    • Relacionamento prévio com pediatras e nutricionistas infantis
Conhecimentos Técnicos
  • Leitura crítica de literatura científica e Medicina Baseada em Evidências
  • Nutrição Infantil: aleitamento materno, fórmulas especiais, APLV, distúrbios gastrointestinais pediátricos
  • Ferramentas: CRM, Excel, PowerPoint, plataformas digitais de visitação e webinars
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado para leitura científica (desejável)
Competências que fazem a diferença
  • Comunicação científica de alto impacto e credibilidade técnica
  • Escuta ativa e inteligência emocional
  • Curiosidade científica e pensamento analítico
  • Capacidade de networking científico e influência ética
  • Autonomia, resiliência e orientação para resultados

Esta posição foi concebida para desenvolver profissionais de excelência científica, combinando Representação Médica, Educação em Saúde e MSL, formando uma nova geração de especialistas em Nutrição Infantil.

- Integração de agentes com fontes de conhecimento externas (SharePoint, sites, documentos).

- Habilidade de comunicar arquiteturas técnicas para públicos técnicos e executivos. Diferencial: Experiência com Azure DevOps ou GitHub Actions para CI/CD de soluções de IA (MLOps light);

Experiência com Azure API Management (APIM) para expor e governar endpoints de IA;
Familiaridade com conectores customizados e extensões de agente (Copilot extensibility);
Conhecimento de Azure SQL, Cosmos DB ou PostgreSQL para persistência em soluções de IA;
Experiência com Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) ou containerização de modelos/aplicações;
Familiaridade com monitoramento de IA: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, logging de prompts/respostas;
Certificação AI-102 (Azure AI Engineer Associate);

Estruturar e manter controles, relatórios, indicadores e playbooks operacionais, garantindo previsibilidade à área. O que buscamos: Perfil organizado, executor e analítico, com forte senso de acompanhamento. Boa comunicação institucional, verbal e escrita. Capacidade de gerir múltiplas demandas simultaneamente. Facilidade de relacionamento com stakeholders. Experiência com organização de projetos e processos. Excel ou Google Sheets intermediário. Diferenciais: Experiência com parcerias institucionais ou relações institucionais. Experiência com entidades, associações ou universidades. Experiência em startups, SaaS ou tecnologia - preferencialmente legaltech. Familiaridade com CRM e ferramentas de gestão. Experiência com eventos ou ações institucionais. Strong understanding of Brazil’s crypto and financial regulatory environment, including digital asset frameworks and payment systems (e.G., PIX) Familiarity with AML/CFT regulations, data protection financial services in Brazil Proven experience handling regulatory licensing, compliance frameworks, and regulator engagement in Brazil Ability to advise on regulatory implications for product design, modification, and market expansion Strong ability to navigate a dynamic and evolving regulatory landscape with ambiguity Excellent stakeholder management skills and ability to work cross-functionally Portuguese (Mandarin is a plus but not required) Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively and deliver practical, scalable compliance solutions Proficiency in MS Office applications Working at For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress. EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required. Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English. Tasks and responsibilities: Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency;
Identify and remediatedata quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders;
Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications;
Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps;
Maintain a centralizedlog or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization;
Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots;
Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials;
Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;
Profile: Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline;
+8 years of overall experience in Information Technology;
+3 years of experiencesupporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams;
Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting;
Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize);
Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights;
Solid understanding ofEnterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making;
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates;
Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred;
Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail;
AI literacy, includingpractical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks;
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders;
Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes;
Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices;
Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including: TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);
ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;
Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus;
Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage;
Fluent in English;

Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, or other external stakeholders is advantageous. Exposure to licensing, regulatory approvals, or compliance projects is beneficial. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Servicenow Application Portfolio Management (Apm) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor In Usd
description:

Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress. EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required. Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English. Tasks and responsibilities: Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency;
Identify and remediatedata quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders;
Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications;
Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps;
Maintain a centralizedlog or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization;
Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots;
Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials;
Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;
Profile: Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline;
+8 years of overall experience in Information Technology;
+3 years of experiencesupporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams;
Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting;
Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize);
Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights;
Solid understanding ofEnterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making;
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates;
Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred;
Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail;
AI literacy, includingpractical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks;
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders;
Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes;
Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices;
Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including: TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);
ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;
Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus;
Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage;
Fluent in English;

Monitor regulatory developments and provide guidance on relevant regulatory requirements. Maintain relationships with regulators and support regulatory enquiries, reviews, and examinations. Identify compliance risks and work with stakeholders to implement appropriate controls and solutions. Prepare compliance updates and reporting for management. Deliver compliance training and promote a strong culture of compliance across the organization. Collaborate with regional and global teams on compliance-related matters. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field. Experience in Compliance, AML/Financial Crime, Regulatory Affairs, or a related function within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or digital assets. Prior experience as an MLRO, Compliance Officer, or similar compliance role is preferred. Good understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements and AML/CFT obligations. Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, or other external stakeholders is advantageous. Exposure to licensing, regulatory approvals, or compliance projects is beneficial. Experience within digital assets, fintech, payments, or financial institutions is preferred. Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently in a dynamic and evolving environment. Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, CFE, or equivalent are a plus. Fluency in English and Portuguese. Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Implantação e projeto de 10 meses (mínimo). Overview We are seeking an experienced Head of Compliance & MLRO to oversee the company's compliance and regulatory responsibilities in Brazil. This role will support the business in maintaining a strong compliance culture, managing regulatory relationships, and ensuring alignment with applicable legal and regulatory requirements. Working closely with local and regional stakeholders, the successful candidate will provide practical compliance guidance while supporting the company's growth and licensing initiatives in Brazil. Key Responsibilities Serve as the designated MLRO and lead compliance representative for the Brazil business. Oversee the company's compliance, AML/CFT, sanctions, and financial crime programs. Monitor regulatory developments and provide guidance on relevant regulatory requirements. Maintain relationships with regulators and support regulatory enquiries, reviews, and examinations. Support licensing, registration, and other regulatory initiatives as required. Provide compliance advice to business and operational teams on new products, services, and business activities. Help ensure policies, procedures, and controls remain effective and aligned with regulatory expectations. Oversee key compliance processes, including customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting. Identify compliance risks and work with stakeholders to implement appropriate controls and solutions. Prepare compliance updates and reporting for management. Deliver compliance training and promote a strong culture of compliance across the organization. Collaborate with regional and global teams on compliance-related matters. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field. Experience in Compliance, AML/Financial Crime, Regulatory Affairs, or a related function within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or digital assets. Prior experience as an MLRO, Compliance Officer, or similar compliance role is preferred. Good understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements and AML/CFT obligations. Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, or other external stakeholders is advantageous. Exposure to licensing, regulatory approvals, or compliance projects is beneficial. Experience within digital assets, fintech, payments, or financial institutions is preferred. Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently in a dynamic and evolving environment. Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, CFE, or equivalent are a plus. Fluency in English and Portuguese. Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Junior Writer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Junior Writer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Junior Writer Location: Remote Position Type: Contract Company: Pocket FM About Us At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series. Role Overview As a Junior Writer, you will be responsible for adapting and localizing English content into portuguese - culturally relevant versions, ensuring narrative consistency, emotional depth, and audience engagement. You will work closely with editorial, production, and AI teams to refine scripts, monitor performance, and enhance content quality across the platform. Key Responsibilities 1. Content Development & Adaptation Review English show materials (audio/scripts) and prepare localization sheets and concept notes with strong cultural adaptation. Adapt scripts using designated GenAI tools, ensuring proper structuring, tone, and inclusion of emotion tags where required. Review and refine AI-generated translations to ensure alignment with editorial standards, cultural nuances, and narrative integrity. Incorporate editorial and technical feedback to revise and deliver high-quality, polished scripts. Deliver ~300 localized and AI-adapted scripts per month, adhering to timelines and quality benchmarks. 2. Quality Reviews & Continuous Improvement Review published audio episodes and provide structured feedback on AI-generated adaptations. Identify recurring issues in translation, tone, or storytelling and recommend improvements. Analyze user comments and feedback to enhance content quality and relevance. 3. Production Support & Quality Assurance Suggest suitable voice-over artists based on character and project requirements Ensure produced content aligns with creative intent and quality standards Conduct quality checks on production samples and provide actionable feedback to ensure “first-time-right” output. 4. Promotion Support Develop concepts and draft scripts for promotional content (10–60 minutes) aligned with series positioning and storytelling goals 5. AI-Driven Editorial Innovation & Tool Adoption Demonstrate hands-on usage of AI tools to enhance editorial workflows, script development, research, adaptation, and content optimization. Apply strong editorial judgment while leveraging GenAI tools to ensure narrative quality, factual consistency, cultural sensitivity, and platform standards. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, or related Strong storytelling skills with an understanding of narrative structure, character development, and pacing. Familiarity with AI-based writing or content adaptation tools is preferred Experience in content localization, translation review, or scriptwriting is a plus. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain consistency across high-volume deliverables. Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret user data and feedback. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced content production environment.

title: Servicenow Application Portfolio Management (Apm) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor In Usd
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Servicenow Application Portfolio Management (Apm) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor In Usd em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress. EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required. Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English. Tasks and responsibilities: Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency;
Identify and remediatedata quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders;
Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications;
Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps;
Maintain a centralizedlog or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization;
Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots;
Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials;
Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;
Profile: Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline;
+8 years of overall experience in Information Technology;
+3 years of experiencesupporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams;
Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting;
Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize);
Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights;
Solid understanding ofEnterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making;
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates;
Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred;
Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail;
AI literacy, includingpractical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks;
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders;
Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes;
Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices;
Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including: TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);
ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;
Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus;
Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage;
Fluent in English;

The successful candidate will lead regulatory and licensing efforts related to crypto operations in Brazil while supporting regional expansion initiatives. de Valores Mobiliários (CVM), and other relevant authorities Monitor and interpret developments in Brazil’s crypto regulatory framework (e.G., Law No. 14,478/2022 and related regulations), and assess their impact on business operations Act as the primary project manager for licensing and regulatory initiatives, coordinating with external counsel, consultants, and internal stakeholders Provide clear, practical, and solution-oriented compliance guidance to product, operations, and business teams to enable compliant product launches and expansion Deliver internal training programs and update training materials to reflect regulatory changes and best practices Represent the company in interactions with regulators, financial institutions, partners, and industry groups in Brazil Knowledge: Strong understanding of Brazil’s crypto and financial regulatory environment, including digital asset frameworks and payment systems (e.G., PIX) Familiarity with AML/CFT regulations, data protection (LGPD), and financial consumer protection laws in Brazil Experience in the crypto, fintech, or payments industry is highly preferred Understanding of global regulatory trends in digital assets is a plus Requirements: Bachelor’s Degree in Law, Finance, Business, or a related field 7 to 9 years of regulatory compliance experience, with at least 3 years focused on crypto, fintech, payments, or financial services in Brazil Proven experience handling regulatory licensing, compliance frameworks, and regulator engagement in Brazil Ability to advise on regulatory implications for product design, modification, and market expansion Strong ability to navigate a dynamic and evolving regulatory landscape with ambiguity Excellent stakeholder management skills and ability to work cross-functionally with senior management Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to remain composed under pressure Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Portuguese (Mandarin is a plus but not required) Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively and deliver practical, scalable compliance solutions Proficiency in MS Office applications Working at BingX Join a diverse, international team with a global mindset. Grow your career in a fast-moving Web3 and fintech environment. Work on meaningful products that serve millions of users worldwide. Enjoy competitive compensation and flexible work arrangements, depending on role requirements. Follow your local public holiday calendar, with additional benefits based on local policies.

title: Quality Assurance Automação
description:

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade imediata para profissional especialista em Qualidade de Softwares com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. O QA de Automação é o profissional responsável por estruturar, implementar e sustentar a automação de testes ao longo do ciclo de desenvolvimento, assegurando qualidade, rastreabilidade e velocidade nas entregas. Sua atuação vai além da execução técnica: ele contribui para a prevenção de defeitos, fortalecimento da cultura de qualidade e aumento da confiança do time nas releases. Esse papel é especialmente relevante em ambientes com entregas contínuas, múltiplas integrações e necessidade de regressão frequente, pois reduz esforço manual, aumenta a previsibilidade e melhora a estabilidade do produto. Escopo de atuação O profissional atua na definição da estratégia de testes automatizados, desenho de cenários críticos, implementação de frameworks, integração com pipelines, análise de falhas, manutenção da suíte de regressão e apoio à evolução das práticas de qualidade do time. Responsabilidades Implementar, manter e evoluir testes automatizados para aplicações web, APIs e, quando aplicável, fluxos integrados entre sistemas. Participar da análise de requisitos, refinamentos e critérios de aceite, contribuindo com visão preventiva de qualidade desde as etapas iniciais do desenvolvimento. Definir a melhor abordagem de automação para cada contexto, equilibrando cobertura, custo de manutenção, estabilidade e retorno sobre investimento. Integrar a execução dos testes automatizados às pipelines de CI/CD, garantindo feedback rápido e confiável para o time. Estruturar e manter massa de testes, dados de apoio, mocks, stubs e evidências necessárias para execução consistente dos cenários automatizados. Monitorar falhas recorrentes, identificar causas-raiz e atuar em conjunto com desenvolvedores e demais QAs na melhoria contínua da qualidade. Acompanhar indicadores de qualidade, cobertura, tempo de execução, taxa de falhas e efetividade da automação. Apoiar a definição e evolução de padrões, boas práticas, convenções de código e arquitetura dos frameworks de teste. Contribuir com a estratégia de Shift Left, promovendo testes antecipados, prevenção de defeitos e maior colaboração entre QA, desenvolvimento e produto. Documentar cenários, fluxos automatizados, premissas técnicas e limitações da suíte de testes para facilitar reuso e manutenção. Competências técnicas esperadas Experiência com automação de testes para API e Web. Conhecimento em C# e/ou Python, com boa base de lógica, estruturação de código e manutenção de automações. Vivência com ferramentas e frameworks como Selenium, Robot Framework, ReqNRoll ou equivalentes. Experiência com testes orientados a comportamento, quando aplicável, utilizando BDD para estruturar cenários de negócio. Conhecimento de integração contínua e pipelines de CI/CD para execução automatizada de testes. Experiência com versionamento de código, preferencialmente com Git. Capacidade de elaborar cenários de teste rastreáveis a requisitos e critérios de aceite. Conhecimento de testes funcionais, regressivos, smoke tests e validação de serviços. Conhecimento de consultas a banco de dados para validação de dados e apoio à investigação de defeitos. Leitura e interpretação de logs, evidências e relatórios de execução. Conhecimentos desejáveis Vivência com ferramentas de observabilidade e dashboards, como Grafana. Experiência com testes de contrato, mocks e virtualização de serviços. Conhecimento de estratégias de qualidade em arquitetura distribuída, microsserviços e integrações. Familiaridade com testes de performance, segurança ou resiliência, mesmo que não seja o foco principal da posição. Vivência com containers, ambientes em nuvem ou orquestração de execução de testes. Conhecimento de métricas de qualidade e governança de testes. Capacidades esperadas Capacidade de construir suítes de testes automatizados reutilizáveis, legíveis e de fácil manutenção. Capacidade de selecionar cenários com maior retorno para automação, evitando baixa eficiência ou excesso de manutenção. Capacidade de estruturar testes com rastreabilidade entre requisito, cenário, evidência e resultado. Capacidade de integrar testes ao fluxo de entrega contínua, com execução confiável e feedback rápido. Capacidade de diagnosticar falhas de automação, diferenciar falso positivo de defeito real e atuar na estabilização da suíte. Capacidade de colaborar com o time para elevar a maturidade de qualidade e prevenir defeitos desde o início do ciclo. Requisitos de formação e experiência Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas. Experiência prévia com qualidade de software, testes automatizados e atuação em times ágeis. Vivência com metodologias ágeis, especialmente Scrum ou Kanban. Experiência em interação com times multidisciplinares, incluindo desenvolvimento, produto e QA manual. Diferenciais desejáveis Ter certificações em testes, qualidade ou automação. Ter experiência em ambientes regulados, sistemas críticos ou produtos com alta necessidade de rastreabilidade. Ter vivência com testes em arquitetura de microsserviços, mensageria, filas ou integrações complexas. Ter atuado na criação de frameworks do zero ou na modernização de esteiras de qualidade. Experiência em projetos de Inteligência Artificial.

description:

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade imediata para profissional especialista em Qualidade de Softwares com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. O QA de Automação é o profissional responsável por estruturar, implementar e sustentar a automação de testes ao longo do ciclo de desenvolvimento, assegurando qualidade, rastreabilidade e velocidade nas entregas. Sua atuação vai além da execução técnica: ele contribui para a prevenção de defeitos, fortalecimento da cultura de qualidade e aumento da confiança do time nas releases. Esse papel é especialmente relevante em ambientes com entregas contínuas, múltiplas integrações e necessidade de regressão frequente, pois reduz esforço manual, aumenta a previsibilidade e melhora a estabilidade do produto. Escopo de atuação O profissional atua na definição da estratégia de testes automatizados, desenho de cenários críticos, implementação de frameworks, integração com pipelines, análise de falhas, manutenção da suíte de regressão e apoio à evolução das práticas de qualidade do time. Responsabilidades Implementar, manter e evoluir testes automatizados para aplicações web, APIs e, quando aplicável, fluxos integrados entre sistemas. Participar da análise de requisitos, refinamentos e critérios de aceite, contribuindo com visão preventiva de qualidade desde as etapas iniciais do desenvolvimento. Definir a melhor abordagem de automação para cada contexto, equilibrando cobertura, custo de manutenção, estabilidade e retorno sobre investimento. Integrar a execução dos testes automatizados às pipelines de CI/CD, garantindo feedback rápido e confiável para o time. Estruturar e manter massa de testes, dados de apoio, mocks, stubs e evidências necessárias para execução consistente dos cenários automatizados. Monitorar falhas recorrentes, identificar causas-raiz e atuar em conjunto com desenvolvedores e demais QAs na melhoria contínua da qualidade. Acompanhar indicadores de qualidade, cobertura, tempo de execução, taxa de falhas e efetividade da automação. Apoiar a definição e evolução de padrões, boas práticas, convenções de código e arquitetura dos frameworks de teste. Contribuir com a estratégia de Shift Left, promovendo testes antecipados, prevenção de defeitos e maior colaboração entre QA, desenvolvimento e produto. Documentar cenários, fluxos automatizados, premissas técnicas e limitações da suíte de testes para facilitar reuso e manutenção. Competências técnicas esperadas Experiência com automação de testes para API e Web. Conhecimento em C# e/ou Python, com boa base de lógica, estruturação de código e manutenção de automações. Vivência com ferramentas e frameworks como Selenium, Robot Framework, ReqNRoll ou equivalentes. Experiência com testes orientados a comportamento, quando aplicável, utilizando BDD para estruturar cenários de negócio. Conhecimento de integração contínua e pipelines de CI/CD para execução automatizada de testes. Experiência com versionamento de código, preferencialmente com Git. Capacidade de elaborar cenários de teste rastreáveis a requisitos e critérios de aceite. Conhecimento de testes funcionais, regressivos, smoke tests e validação de serviços. Conhecimento de consultas a banco de dados para validação de dados e apoio à investigação de defeitos. Leitura e interpretação de logs, evidências e relatórios de execução. Conhecimentos desejáveis Vivência com ferramentas de observabilidade e dashboards, como Grafana. Experiência com testes de contrato, mocks e virtualização de serviços. Conhecimento de estratégias de qualidade em arquitetura distribuída, microsserviços e integrações. Familiaridade com testes de performance, segurança ou resiliência, mesmo que não seja o foco principal da posição. Vivência com containers, ambientes em nuvem ou orquestração de execução de testes. Conhecimento de métricas de qualidade e governança de testes. Capacidades esperadas Capacidade de construir suítes de testes automatizados reutilizáveis, legíveis e de fácil manutenção. Capacidade de selecionar cenários com maior retorno para automação, evitando baixa eficiência ou excesso de manutenção. Capacidade de estruturar testes com rastreabilidade entre requisito, cenário, evidência e resultado. Capacidade de integrar testes ao fluxo de entrega contínua, com execução confiável e feedback rápido. Capacidade de diagnosticar falhas de automação, diferenciar falso positivo de defeito real e atuar na estabilização da suíte. Capacidade de colaborar com o time para elevar a maturidade de qualidade e prevenir defeitos desde o início do ciclo. Requisitos de formação e experiência Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas. Experiência prévia com qualidade de software, testes automatizados e atuação em times ágeis. Vivência com metodologias ágeis, especialmente Scrum ou Kanban. Experiência em interação com times multidisciplinares, incluindo desenvolvimento, produto e QA manual. Diferenciais desejáveis Ter certificações em testes, qualidade ou automação. Ter experiência em ambientes regulados, sistemas críticos ou produtos com alta necessidade de rastreabilidade. Ter vivência com testes em arquitetura de microsserviços, mensageria, filas ou integrações complexas. Ter atuado na criação de frameworks do zero ou na modernização de esteiras de qualidade. Experiência em projetos de Inteligência Artificial.

Key Responsibilities Serve as the designated MLRO and lead compliance representative for the Brazil business. Oversee the company's compliance, AML/CFT, sanctions, and financial crime programs. Monitor regulatory developments and provide guidance on relevant regulatory requirements. Maintain relationships with regulators and support regulatory enquiries, reviews, and examinations. Support licensing, registration, and other regulatory initiatives as required. Provide compliance advice to business and operational teams on new products, services, and business activities. Help ensure policies, procedures, and controls remain effective and aligned with regulatory expectations. Oversee key compliance processes, including customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting. Identify compliance risks and work with stakeholders to implement appropriate controls and solutions. Prepare compliance updates and reporting for management. Deliver compliance training and promote a strong culture of compliance across the organization. Collaborate with regional and global teams on compliance-related matters. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field. Experience in Compliance, AML/Financial Crime, Regulatory Affairs, or a related function within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or digital assets. Prior experience as an MLRO, Compliance Officer, or similar compliance role is preferred. Good understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements and AML/CFT obligations. Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, or other external stakeholders is advantageous. Exposure to licensing, regulatory approvals, or compliance projects is beneficial. Experience within digital assets, fintech, payments, or financial institutions is preferred. Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently in a dynamic and evolving environment. Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, CFE, or equivalent are a plus. Fluency in English and Portuguese. Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Se você possui facilidade de comunicação em inglês e expertise em grandes volumes de dados, essa vaga é para você. Diferenciais: Conhecimento profundo em SAP Data Services (BODS). · Certificação SAP S/4HANA. · Entendimento preliminar dos impactos da Reforma Tributária brasileira no ambiente SAP. · Experiência anterior em projetos com metodologia SAP Activate. · Habilidade em lidar com gestão de mudanças (Change Management) técnica junto ao cliente. Localidade da posição: Belo Horizonte - MG Formato de atuação: Remoto com viagens para MG Idioma: Inglês - Nível: Avançado Porque construir sua carreira na Meta? all customer and internal work is conducted in English;
(additional languages preferred, especially Portuguese)Demonstrated experience managing more than three enterprise customers simultaneously, across multiple countries. title: Ai / Ml Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai / Ml Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. We are looking for a remote, full-time AI / ML Engineer with 4+ years of machine learning experience, preferably within MarTech SaaS companies, to join the engineering team of our U.S. client. You will join our client's innovative, growing team on a mission to unleash the power of culture for growing organizational brands at a time of global, seismic cultural transformation. You will work with the AI / ML Manager on the Data Science team, developing agentic AI workflows with customized hybrid retrieval and contextual pipelines. The right candidate will have the opportunity to develop a wide range of machine learning and AI techniques to create features for the client's UI / UX and internal tools. You will work collaboratively with, and be a key member of, the research and development team, collaborating closely with software engineers, research teams, and product design, creating novel methods for automating the generation of these data-driven insights from PoC all the way to deployment at scale within the client platform. If you are a self-starter who enjoys a fast-paced, dynamic, and autonomous environment as well as thrive in challenging situations, then you are the right person for the job. The ideal candidate must collaborate well within a team, leverage strong Generative AI and Machine Learning expertise, and adeptly apply and adapt existing code, innovating new approaches needed to deliver on insights. Our client unleashes the power of culture, driving brand growth with consumer insights, analytics, tools, and best practices for over 250 major U.S. brands. Its solutions are fueled by its cultural intelligence platform, which allows its customers to more effectively and efficiently understand, reach, and engage consumers, activating them across race, ethnicity, generation, gender, and sexual identity. Our client comprises creative, analytical, diverse, hardworking, and fun individuals with an insatiable curiosity for the new collage of behaviors and patterns driving consumers today. The possibilities of the moment and opportunity to help organizations unlock their cultural capacity inspire them to seek out predictive insights and brand impacts that are unique to their model. Responsibilities Develop a wide range of data science techniques, including supervised and unsupervised learning, dimensionality reduction, network analyses, natural language processing, statistical analyses, classification, and similarity modelling. Partner with product and engineering teams to execute in an Agile development environment. Research market trends and innovations in data technologies and analytical approaches to drive innovation while facilitating data platform scalability Develop features with LLMs, VLMs, and ViTs that enable analysis, summarization, and production-ready output of content using the client's internal research data. Develop and maintain strong retrieval augmented generation pipelines with customized time sensitivity, hybrid search methods, and weighting. Develop REST API Endpoints to allow the application's backend to service from the client's AI workflows, maintaining and monitoring token expenditure, latency, and related metrics. Experience with prompt engineering for complex and multi-agent pipelines efficiently, ensuring regression compatibility and with guardrails for hallucination. Develop and design integrations and MCPs with both unstructured and structured data into efficient tools used by AI Agents. Required Experience Excellent English communication and teamwork skills 4+ years of professional experience as a data scientist, preferably in the marketing area 4+ years of relevant work experience in a machine learning or data science role;
experience specificallyin consumer advertising and marketing or social media is a plus Strong Python skills and/or other platforms and languages (e.G., Hadoop, Spark, SQL, R) and Python libraries Business experience solving analytical issues through quantitative approaches and machine learning methods, as well as experience using advanced statistical methods, data mining techniques, and information retrieval Experience in applying data science methodologies to solve problems, particularly in the marketing domain Experience working with AI and machine learning for product development with LiteLLM, CrewAI, Langchain, Langraph, and similar wrappers. Experience working with AI observability, tracing, spans, and tools tracking (DataDog Observability, Langfuse, Langchain, Arize, or others) Knowledge of probability and statistics (e.G., distributions, hypothesis testing, time series concepts, Bayesian framework) Truly a team player: likes to work with others to get a clear understanding of the context around the data;
can happily interact with extraverted thinkers;
and can adapt to new information High comfort in analyzing and manipulating large, complex, high-dimensional data from numerous sources Experience working in a cloud environment (AWS preferred) Curiosity and passion for learning Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent Desired Experience Advanced university degree (master's degree or equivalent degree) in computer science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, physics, econometrics, or equivalent quantitative fields Additional Information Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big! You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions Work with smart and creative people Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent! We recognize you as an individual with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you! 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays Start: ASAP About Velozient We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!
